verdict.rationale: Windmill is a workflow automation platform, so a prebuilt connector catalog is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents a library of prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations covering many apps. What it does show is adjacent: code in many languages, event triggers such as Kafka, Postgres and SQS, and AI-provider connections in agent steps. None of these is a maintained app-integration catalog.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations
